prompt.task: Identify the underlying pattern of the following number series.
prompt.data_context: The data only consists of every third value of the number series (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th...). It is one of the following series: even numbers, odd numbers, prime numbers, square numbers, series of values from the harmonic oscillator.
prompt.desired_output: Decide which of the series named in data_context is present, name the series and complete the series up to the maximum value in the data, with matching timestamps, fill in the missing values, and return only a Python Dictionairy with the complete series of numbers and timestamps, without code.
